src:
I just need one more week! I can pay you
the $5,000 that I owe, but the Governor is bribing

my ranch hands to leave,
I can't do it by myself.

Well, why don't you just sell up to the Governor.
You could always move into town
and work in the saloon.

The Saloon! How dare you!
I just need one more week!
I don't think the owner of the bank would approve.
Well maybe I can speak with him myself.

I’m sorry, but the governor is too busy
for the likes of you.

To hell with that evil son of a bitch! He’s mined
enough gold out of Bear Mountain!
What the hell does he want with my damn ranch!
Ma'am?
I’m sorry, sir. How may I be of assistance?
I want my money!
We have a small problem.

Then tell me about the gold in bear mountain
that young lady was talking about.
I’m sorry I can’t disclose anything about our clients.

Then tell me where she lives.
And when I get back, you better have my gold!
All I'm saying, is if it was me that lost an arm,

Well maybe, but a cannon?
Well that's too much gun for any man!

Cork your whisky holes.
You didn't know him before, like I did.

Only a cannon could replace that
man’s arm.
How did he lose his arm?

We ain't telling you nothing stranger!
Near as I can tell, we ain't even talking to you!
Take a walk!
Answer my question and I'll be on my way.

Well shut up! Don't tell this stinking
prairie dog nothing!
Ain't that right, Sam?
I reckon so. . .
Say goodbye, Mister.

Your pretty handy in a fight, stranger,
but you lost your guns in all the ruckus,
here they are.

I guess you’ve still got some business with
them brothers.
They ain’t what you’d call kindly fellows.

Well, good luck to you, but I got to look out for
myself, so this door is getting locked behind you.

Your pretty good in a fight, stranger.
The only problem is you lost your guns
in all the ruckus.
Here you go.

Looks like you still got some business
with them brothers.
They ain’t what you call kindly fellows.
Open the damn door, woman!
Well, good luck to you,

but I got to look out for myself,
so this door is getting locked behind you.
Hey, friend.
Follow me, I know a short cut.

Friend! You go ahead,
I’ll follow you!

I could hear your coming, little man.
You think you can handle taking
on a woman like me?
You either drunk or crazy.
Hate to kill a lady.

There are too many of them. The bridge must
be destroyed. Set the charges where you must.
But general that would be suicide.

It certainly will be if you don’t.
Ándale! Ándale!
Hahahahahahaha!

Finally. We just been killing time since
Mr. Kelley made us guard this hole in the ground,
but it looks like things are picking up.
That's bad luck for you, stranger.
Cousin!

If we wait much longer for the cavalry
they will be rescuing our corpses.

If we attack that gatling gun head on we'll both die.
I’ll draw their fire while you try to find
a way inside the walls.
Revenge shall be mine!

Many are the dead who have prayed for this moment.
You have done well Red, but his master,
Diego, still lives.

That’s Diego’s war train
Go, cousin, finish what you have started.

Our people now shall know of your courage,
cousin.
Excuse me, excuse me, sir.

I seem to have found myself in a most
unfortunate situation.
If you would be kind enough to help me.
You ain’t my problem.

Indeed sir, however, you might feel
differently once you look behind you.

I’m guessing there’s more where they came from.
That contraption should make short
work of them. I’ll cover you.
You’re going to blow up real good, cowboy!

Thank you sir, your help has been immensely
appreciated. If I can be of any assistance whatsoever,
do not hesitate to call on me.

Now, if you’ll excuse me,
I have a certain debt to collect from
Professor Perry and his circus crew.
Good day to you.
Your judgment day has come.
PSST! Whoa! Easy there, uh, friend!

Come over here. Come on now.
It’s too dangerous for a man to be walking
around in these parts!
I deal in weapons and goods. See?

I would offer you more than,
hehehe but a gang of ruffians done run me

offa my, oh uh,
well I didn't uh,

You holding out on us, old man?
No!
What the hell you looking at?
Fill him full of lead!
I’m going to make mincemeat out of you!
Damn, son! You done killed them all!

You know you can get quite a handsome
bounty for these fellas,

if you took them down to Sheriff O’Grady
in Widow’s Patch.
I’ll be taking your cart.

Uh, well uh, sure, whatever
you say, bounty hunter.

Well, it’s been a week since General Diego
captured me.
I know nothing about being a bounty hunter,

but I’ve been a slave once and
ain’t no way I’m gonna do it again.
Cousin Red?
Shadow wolf? Over here.

I knew I would find you;
the blood bond between us is strong.

I’ll go to Brimstone and get help.
I’ll have the Cavalry here in no time!

Go fast, Soldier.  We will have no
chance for escape unless we separate,

I will go this way and
meet you at Diego’s fort.

Anyone comes through that gate, you kill them.
I don’t care if it’s your Grannie’s ghost,

you put a bullet in between their eyes,
and you don't stop shooting that rifle until

you ain’t have no bullets left.
You understand me?

Let's see if we can find a way in
that will attract a little less attention.
I'll go round this way.
I’m going straight in.

I think a frontal assault is out of the question.
Suggestions?
Follow me. And shoot anything that moves.
Dammit!

The only thing left in my bag of tricks
is to pick the damn lock on the front door.

Think you two can keep me from
getting shot in the back while I do it?

Only one way to find out.
I'll cover you from up here with my rifle.
All right then mate, follow me!
I got it! Let’s go!

That no good Governor is going to be
sorry he burned down my ranch after
I get through with this fancy house.

I don’t think the Governor is going to be in
a position to care about much of anything soon.
Keep your heads down boys.

Right! A secret door! That’s the stuff!
Probably leads right to the bastard!

I'll keep these devils at bay,
you see where that passage leads.

I busted up the place something good,
found the keys to the whole place
on one of them dead bluejackets.

Still ain’t seen hide nor hair of that
sneaky Governor, though.

Let’s keep moving,
he’s got to be around here somewhere.
Hey soldier, ready to do some fighting?
Just point me in the right direction, ma'am.

You two go on and look for the governor.
I'm going to stay here and find Mr. Swift.
I’m afraid the Governor is otherwise occupied.

Next time, I suggest you make an appointment,
only there ain't going to be no next time.

You got no chance son,
best you just turn around and keep on going.
Ain’t no shame in cheating death twice.

I’ve got some nitro I found there in the Governor's
office, you lay down some fire and
I'll take that gate right down.

Best way to help me is to put a bullet in
that man's brain.
Get going, Bounty Hunter!

I always regretted what happened back
on your daddy's farm, Red.
I should have been there,
to make sure you joined them.
But lucky for me, I get a second chance.
Never did like him much.
Jack?

Well Red, I'm not saying Griffon didn’t
deserve it, but he was the Governor.

I reckon the army will be sniffing around here and…
well I’d hate to see you hang after all you’ve done.
$5000 in gold sound like a fair bounty?
It was never about the money. Give it to them.
Whoa!
Hey there, you going to Brimstone?

Close enough, I suppose.   The express road
passes about a mile outside of town.

Well, I gotta get to the governor so he can call out
the troops. There’s trouble heading from down South.
Well climb on back soldier.

Governor, you have to contact
General Bodie right away!
Who let you in here, Soldier?

There’s a renegade general named Diego in your
territory who’s running a gold mine using slave labour.

I’m afraid it’s a job only the U.S. Army can handle, sir.
He has an army of his own, and a fort, too!

Thank you soldier, in fact General Diego’s my biggest contributor.
I’m sure this is all a misunderstanding.
Mr. Kelly here will take good care of you.

Brimstone just a mile or so that away. Sorry I can’t take
you in, but there are some desperate folks
waitin’ for these here supplies.

Much obliged, mister.
I’ll be sure to tell the Governor you helped me.
Who knows, maybe there’s a reward in it for you.

If it’s all the same, I’d rather Governor Griffin
don’t even know who I am.
Good luck to you, soldier.

Darlin!
Pa!
Son! Our troubles are finally over!

We hit a vein of gold as wide as a locomotive
that runs clean through Bear Mountain!
Hey Pa, where did you get that?
Isn’t she a beaut?
Yeah! Can I hold it?
She’s one of a pair. Only 2 in the whole world.
Where's the other one?

My partner Griff has it.
We made them up special to symbolize
our new found wealth!
Can I try it out?

One day this fine weapon will be yours.
But for now why don’t you take my old pistol.

Go on down to the river and
practice while I give your Ma her gifts.

Red! Red Harlow!
What are you doing to my pots and pans!
Ha Ha. Now don’t henpeck the boy.

Next trip into town, I’ll
buy you a whole bunch of new pots and pans.

Red! Up the hill and quick, boy!
We’re getting raided!
I’m coming Pa!

No!
Don't!

Pa! Pa! Get up, pa!
Pa! Pa! Get up, pa! Pa! Pa!

Kid, I reckon your pa’s better off dead,
him being such a yellow-belly and all.

Sorry, Annie, but the Governor
made us a better offer.  Good luck. --SAM.
God not you, too, Sam!
I've got something for you!
Come out and play.
Ma’am.
Do I know you, stranger?
Tell me about the Gold Mine in Bear Mountain.
I know nothing about a gold mine.

You might want to take a trip on down
to the saloon in Brimstone.

It’s always littered with a
bunch of drunks yapping about it.

But watch yourself mister. You want no
business with the folks in that town.
This place is all I've ever known.
Ma’am.

Five thousand pieces in gold.
This’ll help me keep my ranch!

He’s killed so many men down south,
he had to come up north to find some more;
Senor Gabriel Navarro!!!

Challenging him,  a man of mystery.
Some of you may have heard of all the recent bounty
hunting he did on behalf of our the town.
Ladies and Gentleman…Red!

He’s killed so many men down south,
he had to come up north to find some more;
Senor Gabriel Navarro!

Challenging him, a man of mystery. Some of you
may have heard of all the recent bounty
hunting he did on behalf of the town.
Ladies and gentlemen, Red!
That should leave a bruise!

I don’t reckon he should be so eager to get
himself killed, but rules is the rules and there’s
no denying he’s quick on the draw.

He can’t shave but he sure can shoot,
the challenger, Kid Cougar!

For our semi-final round, we have a three time winner
and current champion,

the sharpest shooter and
dresser in the whole territory, Mister Kelley!

The brave soul challenging him is a man who's
killed a lot of bad men around here and is looking
to kill some more. . . Red!

Due to the sudden absence of Sheriff Bartlett,
I’m going to be stepping in to oversee this uh,
conclusion to the Battle Royale.

Now whereas the two gentlemen before us are clearly
the best, I believe a change of the rules is in order.
I hereby disqualify Jack Swift and Annie Stoakes.

The winner of this here round is going
to be the winner of the Battle Royale.
Well Red you’re good, I’ll give you that.

But of course you’d have to be to
live through what you did.

Still I'm afraid that we’re going to have to end
right here and now what we should have been ended
so many years ago.

Isn't she a beut?
Yeah! Can I hold it?

She's one of a pair.  Only 2 in the whole world.
Where's the other one?

Mr. Kelley, please join me at the mansion
when you’ve finally taken care of business.

Well, I guess I just lost my chance at
five thousand in gold.

A small price to pay to avoid
shooting you, madam.
Jack Swift, you’re just lucky to be alive.
Sheriff? Are you alright?
I’m alright!
Tell me where to find him.
His mansion!  But it’s secured like a fortress.
It’ll be hard even for a Bounty Hunter like you.
He will not be alone.

He ain’t the only one that wants the governor. I reckon
that there prize money is in that mansion of his.
I’m looking at a dead man.

Where you running off to sheriff?! You might
have beaten my gang, but you ain’t gonna get by me!

You cowards!
Somebody let me free!

Oh, Mister, mister, please!
You got to cut me loose!  Mister, please!
Who’s up for some barbeque?
Jack! What an unpleasant suprise.

That wasn't very nice Jack.
Don’t bet on making it out again.

That was incredible.
You saved my life!

All in a day's work. I only wish
it were more financially gratifying.

Well shoot, Mister, if getting yourself a little
money is all your worried about

then, I know where someone with your talent could
pick up five thousand dollars in gold
without even trying!

Pray do tell, young lady, and
I will be forever in your debt!

There’s a sharpshooter competion in Brimstone,
winner takes all.

Shouldn’t be a problem for such a
fine marksmen like yourself.
Well, madam.

Time for a little pick me up I think.
My boys will keep you busy.
All this excitement has made me quite thirsty!
Dammit, I've almost run dry.
Okay, Swift, I've had enough of you now.
Well look at what we got here!

If there’s anything I can’t stand, it’s
a varmint what don’t know it's own business.
Now the real show begins!
You the bounty hunter?

Sheriff Bartlett. I got your telegram.
Mighty grateful to you.

I may have some work for you.
Stop by my office later.

Come to try you hand at
the $5000 in gold I see.

You are a man of few words, I respect that.
I truly do.

I believe you are somewhat acquainted with
Miss Stoakes.
Did you find what you were lookin’ for, stranger?
I reckon’ I did.
Do you see a buffalo soldier ride into town.

That BOY!  He won't be causing
the governor anymore problems.

I do hope you are planning to attend the Battle Royale.
I would very much look forward to beating
an adversary of your talent.
I just signed up.
That should leave a bruise!

I don’t reckon he should be so eager to get
himself killed, but rules is the rules and there’s
no denying he’s quick on the draw.

He can’t shave but he sure can shoot,
the challenger, Kid Cougar!

If you’re as good a bounty hunter as O’Grady
says you are, you could help me with

a couple of real outlaws wreaking havoc
in my territory.
It’d be worth a pretty penny to you!

You might want to start with Pig Josh,
he’s one crazy outlaw and circus freak.
Just be careful he’s got a hankering for dynamite.

Oh, you might wanna keep your eyes out for
some English fellar, he don’t know what a
motley crew he keeping company with.

Not bad bounty hunter.  Not bad at all.
Now I reckon you could really line your pockets,
if you don’t mind hunting down a woman.
If you can call her a woman.

Hahahahaha,
I reckon that old Bessie was a real handful.

Take care of this last one and
I will make it worth your while.

Mr. Black, he’s a strange one. Truth be told,
I ain't even sure if he’s alive,

but he’s hurt a lot of good folk in this town
and he needs taking care of.

You’re one hell of a bounty hunter, Mister.
You’d make me one fine deputy.
I just want my money.

From what I hear the wagon hasn’t
arrived with the banks gold.

You’ll have to take that up with
Mr. Peabody, the bank manager.
Bandits!

Well, bounty hunter, if you want this train to make
it to Brimstone you better load up them guns of yours.

Brothers, here's a robbery.
Nobody plays hero, nobody dies.
It is far from over Gringo!

I have gold, lots of it, you can
have it if you spare my life.
Whiskey, women, fine weapons,
anything you want.
What do you say, Partner?

This train is gonna fly off the tracks!
I gotta slow it down!
Woo, that was close.

Hey, thanks for saving me.
Here, let me patch you up a bit.
